actors.description: First-time visitor evaluating the contract-driven AI orchestration model.
goals: Inspect skill tree architecture and verification gates
Compare landing page experience against reference (resend.com)
Evaluate pricing tiers and open source licensing
Register for early access waitlist or subscribe to developer updates

actors.description: Engineering lead assessing build reproducibility and security hardening for team adoption.
goals: Audit the 9 foundational contracts (Working, Wiring, Integrity, Hardening, Completeness, Consistency, Load-Once, Repair, Maintenance)
Verify absence of hallucinations, unverified credentials, and slop copy
Review zero-trust API boundaries and SBOM compliance

actors.description: Developer actively running build tree nodes to turn reference designs into production code.
goals: Execute topological node pipeline from Tier 1 (Foundation) through Tier 4 (Product)
Run schema validation and automated wiring checks before files land

actors.description: Team administrator managing seats, API credentials, and billing limits.
goals: Provision service tokens and webhook endpoint signatures
Manage plan quotas, monthly token budgets, and team permissions
Configure custom reference scraper settings and fallback priorities

actors.description: Auditor inspecting build isolation, default-deny network egress, and secret leakage.
goals: Review automated security reports generated by node 18b / 18d
Verify complete isolation between scraped mirrors and production secrets
Check session.log immutability and provenance tracking

journeys.title: Discovery to Early Access Registration
journeys.trigger: Developer lands on root homepage from GitHub or tech community recommendation.
steps: Visitor arrives at route / and views the Hero headline and interactive terminal showcase
Visitor inspects the Contract Bento Grid to understand the 9 invariant guarantees
Visitor navigates to /pricing to review transparent tier boundaries (Hobby, Indie, Scale)
Visitor enters developer email in the WaitlistForm component on / or /pricing
Client initiates POST /api/waitlist with optimistic UI feedback
Server validates email via Zod schema, checks IP rate limits, and persists record
Client displays position number and invites user to join the Discord community
journeys.outcome: User is registered in waitlist with position confirmation; welcome email dispatched.

journeys.title: Architectural Inspection and Contract Review
journeys.trigger: Tech lead evaluates build reproducibility before authorizing codebase integration.
steps: Evaluator navigates to /about and examines the deterministic build philosophy
Evaluator explores the 61-node interactive graph on / showing Tier 1 through Tier 5 breakdown
Evaluator clicks on individual node badges to view prerequisites and artifact schemas
Evaluator verifies that schema validation gates block incomplete or unverified writes
Evaluator reviews /privacy and /terms to confirm data minimization and intellectual property terms
journeys.outcome: Evaluator verifies system integrity and shares architecture specs with engineering team.

journeys.title: Enterprise and Team Inquiry Submission
journeys.trigger: Team lead requires custom tier limit or enterprise sandbox deployment.
steps: User navigates to route /contact
User fills out name, work email, inquiry subject, and requirements message
Form silently checks anti-bot honeypot field (_gotcha)
Client submits payload to POST /api/contact
Server sanitizes input, verifies CSRF token, and forwards message via Resend SDK
User receives on-screen confirmation and automated receipt email
journeys.outcome: Contact inquiry logged in CRM; notification sent to core engineering team.

journeys.title: Developer Blog Reader to Subscriber
journeys.trigger: Reader discovers an engineering deep-dive on /blog.
steps: Reader visits /blog and reviews technical articles on contract validation
Reader scrolls to bottom newsletter widget
Reader inputs email into newsletter subscription box
POST /api/newsletter triggers audience enrollment
Inline success toast confirms active subscription
journeys.outcome: Reader added to developer digest without cookies or tracking telemetry.

auth.unauthenticated: Visitor browsing public landing page routes with no token or session context.
auth.authenticating: Client awaiting OAuth redirection or magic link token verification.
auth.authenticated: Developer session verified with active scoped JWT stored in HTTP-only secure cookie.
auth.token_expired: Session token reached expiration threshold; automatic silent refresh initiated.
auth.permission_denied: User authenticated but lacking required tier entitlement or workspace role.

data.idle: Form components ready for user input; no active network transmission.
data.fetching: Server components streaming SSR payloads via React Suspense boundaries.
data.mutating: Client submitting lead capture or inquiry payload to API route handler.
data.optimistic_update: Form visually updates to success state before server roundtrip finishes.
data.success: Mutation resolved with HTTP 200; confirmation message or modal rendered.
data.validation_error: Zod parsing failed on client or server; inline field error messages displayed.
data.server_error: API handler returned HTTP 500; localized error banner rendered with retry button.

theme.default: High-contrast developer dark mode (#000000 surface, #09090b cards, #27272a borders).
theme.system_sync: Strictly dark theme enforced per design contract; light mode explicitly disallowed.
theme.reduced_motion_active: prefers-reduced-motion detected; all springs and transforms replaced by opacity fades.

network.online: Full bidirectional connectivity to edge runtime and origin endpoints.
network.offline: Browser offline; form submission cached locally in IndexedDB with pending badge.
network.degraded: API latency exceeding 800ms threshold; spinner transitions to patience message.
network.reconnecting: Network disconnection detected; exponential backoff pinging /api/health.
network.timeout: Request exceeded 10-second timeout ceiling; client displays retry prompt.
